title: Portfolio
intro: A practice portfolio that starts with a fixed amount of simulated cash. No real trade is placed and nothing here is investment advice.

errors.network: The app could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.

board.noProfile: No profile exists yet, so this tab uses the plain-words view and simulated trades are off until the <link>profile questions</link> are answered.
board.layoutPanelSub: Order and visibility of the modules on this tab. Nothing changes until you save.
board.loadError: The simulated portfolio could not be loaded: {error}
board.loading: Loading the simulated portfolio and the last prices…
board.newHere: New here: the simulated portfolio is all cash. Open the <link>Overview tab</link> to see the watchlist built from your profile and add a first simulated position.
board.ruleActed: {count, plural, one {A rule acted: {symbols} (simulated).} other {# rules acted: {symbols} (simulated).}}
board.checkFailed: The rules check did not run: {error}

total.title: Total value
total.noChangeCashOnly: no change: the portfolio holds cash only
total.changeUnavailable: not available: a held asset has no change for today
total.howBody: cash + quantity × last price of each position. Computed {when}
total.fxNote: USD converted at {rate} CAD per USD ({source}).
total.dayNote: Today's change is the move of the positions held now since their previous close, from the same quotes. A position added today counts its whole day, so it can differ from the change since the start.
total.unpriced: Not included, no price available right now: {list}.

performance.title: Performance (simulated)
performance.sub: Value of the simulated portfolio against the starting amount
performance.emptyTitle: No data for this period yet
performance.emptyNoTrade: The chart starts with the first simulated trade. Until then the value is the starting amount.
performance.emptyPeriod: The series has {count, plural, =0 {no point} one {one point} other {# points}} inside {period}. Try a longer period.
performance.overPeriod: {change} CAD over this period · {sinceStart} CAD against the starting amount
performance.chartLabel: Simulated value from {from} to {to}: {first} CAD to {last} CAD. Starting amount {start} CAD.

holdings.title: Holdings (simulated)
holdings.subNovice: What the simulated portfolio holds and how each has moved since it was added
holdings.sub: Positions valued at the last price; return against the average cost in CAD
holdings.emptyBody: The simulated portfolio holds no position yet. The Overview tab lists assets matched to your profile, each with its reasons and sources; from a card you can add one to the simulated portfolio.

reduce.title: Reduce position: {symbol}
reduce.holdNowValue: You hold {units}, {value} CAD at the last price.
reduce.fillNote: The simulation fills at the last price; no real trade is placed.

sector.title: Sector allocation (simulated)
sector.sub: Share of the simulated portfolio's value in each sector
sector.note: Sector tags come from the app's asset list (sector names from the Wikipedia lists it was built from, not a licensed GICS feed); an ETF or a crypto asset is grouped under its asset class. Values are the holdings' values at the last price, as listed under Holdings.
sector.unpriced: Not included, no price available right now: {list}.
